sourceWork: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex (2002), season1

references.facts: Motoko is a top-class prosthetic-body field leader; Aramaki commands Section9. Batou is a cyborg former Ranger. Togusa is organic except his cyberbrain and uses a Mateba revolver. Saito is a sniper with left Hawkeye cybernetic eye and left prosthetic arm; the eye improves rifle accuracy, not a weapon projectile.
Motoko model-sheet profile names Seburo C-26A and M-5, and168cm height. Equipment names establish physical firearms; the project volley is an authored description, not an official ultimate name.
Aramaki is Section9 chief,153cm; Batou is187cm with two prosthetic eyes and a mostly prosthetic body. No cyber-eye projectile ability is stated.
Togusa profile identifies his detective background, nearly organic body, Mateba revolver and178.5cm height.
Saito is identified as the sniper,172cm. His role is physical rifle support.

visualAccessLimits: The official page image links were attempted with the web tool; some image fetches failed. No downloaded official image was used as generation input and exact official costume pixels were not certified. Local old sprites, all15 actual generated source images and the normalized output/contact sheets were visually inspected. Old missing equipment and chibi Aramaki were treated as imperfect context, not visual authority.
rejectedGenerationSource: Aramaki initial32 was rejected for chibi head/body proportions; native text-only replacement accepted. Batou initial victory row contains an extra body and is omitted. Missing rows are supplied only through declared native corrections. No image-generation refusal occurred in this PartC lot.
statureLimit: 190px is a common project standing-body calibration, not a claim to reproduce source character physical heights. Native bends are preserved. Corrective low recovery strips use an explicit approximate comparable-pose density bridge.
